root_cause: Existing chats and agents have frequently reported that a technical merge, successful job or deployment was done while canonical commercial obligations still had three expired/unproven handoffs and zero new verified email addresses. The root AGENTS contract described honesty but did not consistently make the user-facing definition of complete unambiguous for all specialist agents.

evidence.technical_rotation_release: PR #5863 merged + Edge v85 provider parity verified; latest Edge v89 active

owner: Original ONE BRAIN commercial obligation, existing agent-integration-engineer, agent-reliability, agent-data-quality and agent-growth-market; P0 #4198
corrective_action: Declare an agent/chat-wide no-premature-closure rule; preserve separate release, consumer, real provider side-effect, measured business outcome and learning gates; route the three expired handoffs and source debts to original owners without rewriting evidence or adding duplicate schedulers.
prevention_rule: No terminal 'klaar/groen/sluitend' for an underlying business obligation solely from PR, merge, CI, deploy, cron or HTTP success. Require exact original producer→consumer ACK, protected production readback, actual outcome and applied learning; unknown dependencies remain OPEN with root cause, owner, next due action and durable intermediate error record.
